August 11

Worlds Cube Qualifier

Event Starts at 4:30 PM

-$10 Entry Fee

-$3 discount for Premium Members

-Open to all players

-Six Games (play each side 3 times - draft twice)

-45 Minute Timed Games

-2 Day Two byes available to two best swiss scores

Reflections I/Cloud City Draft (May be replaced by a similar event if a more palatable option presents itself)

Event Starts at 10:00 PM

$12 Entry Fee

-Open to all players

-Four Games

-Each player will draft 4 packs of Reflections I and 3 packs of Cloud City

August 12

Worlds Last-Chance Qualifier: Worlds 1998 Format

Event starts at 10:00 AM

-$20 Entry Fee

-$5 discount for Premium Members

-Open to all players

-Worlds 1998 Format- Use only cards from Premiere to Special Edition, plus the six original EPPs (All rules and errata since then will be in place). SPECIAL EXCEPTION: Cards with 'operative' in title are banned for this event.

-Six Games Swiss Pairings

-2 Byes for Worlds 2011 will be given ($20 additional will be collected from the winners of these byes)

-Other prizes TBA

Worlds Day 1- Open Format

Event starts at 4:30 PM

-$40.00 Entry Fee

-$5.00 discount for Premium Members

-Open to all players not holding an automatic bid to Day 2

-Open Constructed Deck Format

-Six Games Swiss Pairings

-Top 50% advance to Day 2 (minimum 4 players)

-Other prizes TBA

Worlds Team Tournament

Event Starts at 5:30 PM

-$20.00 Entry Fee per Team

-$5.00 discount for Premium Members

-Open Constructed Deck Format

-Team Format (Two players per team, each player assigned one side)

-4 Games. You will be paired against another team and scores recorded on a Team command card.

-Automatic bids into Day 2 of 2011 (or 2012 if already qualified) World Championships for the top team

-Other prizes TBA

Ironman Sealed Deck (May be replaced by a similar event if a more palatable option presents itself)

Event Starts at 10:00 PM

-$11 Entry Fee

-Single Elimination

-This sealed-deck format adds new meaning to the word "lost." Whenever a card is lost, placed out of play or discarded, you must physically destroy it! Tear it in half, roll it into a ball, eat it - whatever! The catch: you must play with all of the cards that you are given, and if you drop early from the tournament, you must forfeit all of your cards. Each player will be given the following product: 1 Premiere OTSD and 3 packs of Jabba's Palace. The winner of each game will be given an additional pack.

-4 Games

August 13

Worlds Day 2

Event starts at 10:00 AM

-$40.00 Entry Fee

-Entry Fee waived for players advancing from Day 1

-$5.00 discount for Premium Members

-Open to all players qualified for Day 2

-Open Constructed Deck Format

-Eight Games

-Top eight players advance to Day 3

Reflections III Sealed

Event starts at 5:00 PM

-Entry Fee $20.00

-Open to all players

-Four Games

August 14

Worlds Day 3

Event starts at 10:00

-No Entry Fee

-Match Play

-Constructed Deck

-Higher seed chooses first side

-Games timed to 1:30 minutes each

-Top 2 players advance to Final Confrontation

Worlds Consolation Tournament

Event starts at 10:30

-$20.00 Entry Fee

-$5.00 discount for SWCCGPC premium members

-Open Constructed Deck Format

-Six Games

One event not on the schedule: Chris Menzel (The Euro Emperor) will be joining us at Worlds 2011, and he has offered to sit down and discuss Euro Worlds 2012 with anyone who is interested in attending. He will be happy to answer questions and discuss ideas for a tour of Europe. If anyone has a preference on when this is held, let us know.

i think they'll be ok but i wouldn't play light operatives because of pb3 nor dark operatives because of dtf

I have literally 0 experience with Worlds 98 format, so I'm open to suggestions on legality of operatives. I thought they were fixed with rules more than later cards (although we did find out amusingly at Nationals that the 2 JPSD objectives cannot play operatives...darn Tatooine operatives being so broken!) so using current rules would fix it, but if I'm wrong please do speak up.

...what is PB3?

With the rule change, you just had to put your Operatives in speeders/ywings and use them that way, which was way more effective for LS than for DS.

I think the point of Worlds 98 format was to see what Worlds would have been like without operatives, since that deck dominated the field so much. I would say No characters with the word Operative in their title should be allowed to be played, but would leave the Objectives just as activation platforms for people, like using the obj to start Tatooine and the farm, and then do silly things on tatooine to combat DS's Jabba's Palace activation.

Yeah, I def. agree that the intent is to see what would've happened without them. Let's nuke 'em to the ground. Original post updated.

But if the format is supposed to be worlds 98 w/o the operative mess, why have epps added in as well?

Throdo wrote:But if the format is supposed to be worlds 98 w/o the operative mess, why have epps added in as well?

I guess I just think it should really be like worlds 98 w/o operatives instead of something similar but not really cause all the best characters wouldn't have been released then but its still almost nearly what worlds 98 without operatives could have maybe been like.

The problem with online polls for events like this is there is no way to tell if people who vote for them are actually planning on attending the event.

I don't really care though one way or the other, cause I probably won't be playing in it myself.

darkjediknight11 wrote:Throdo wrote:But if the format is supposed to be worlds 98 w/o the operative mess, why have epps added in as well?

Throdo wrote:But if the format is supposed to be worlds 98 w/o the operative mess, why have epps added in as well?

@Richards: That's because the poll BEFORE it was whether or not to include them if we did Worlds 98, and it was a pretty wide margin in favor.

@Hunter/Throdo: *shrug* If people who are planning on playing in the event would prefer authenticity, I'm fine with changing it, but no one who is playing has spoken up against EPPs.
